contract_file: SRSR_Physics_统一研究问题_一次性数据处理与模型实验总合同.md
main_cohort: 169 existing MATR unique physical cells, no suffix-dependent input admission

discharge.soh100_anchor_reduction: median of valid observed capacities in the registered prefix interval
discharge.absolute_Q_zero: instrument discharge counter zero, verified against pre-discharge samples
discharge.shape_Q_zero: Q at 3.3V, oriented as discharge progresses

split.identity_unit: physical cell UID including cross-batch continuations
split.historical_exposure: All 169 supplied cells participated in historical exploration. New cross-validation is internal exploratory evidence.

training.trajectory_loss: per-cell mean absolute error over all observed valid future cycles

reporting.primary: cell-mean full observed future trajectory MAE and RMSE
reporting.eol80_definition: first interpolated trend crossing of nominal SOH0.8 after cycle100, prediction censored at registered5000 query horizon
reporting.eol80_metric: Harrell concordance over observed EOL80 events and right-censored last-valid original cycles; restrict this secondary endpoint to cells still at risk at100

formal_training_requires: verified DATA_FREEZE.json with complete source identity and original cycle-axis QA
